lines.text: I am seeking a sponsor for an independent study next semester. I propose
to read three of George Eliot's novels and write a paper focusing on Eliot's
I became intrigued by Eliot when I read her novel Middlemarch in your
Victorian Literature course and wanted to explore Eliot's work further.
Since no courses offered this year include her novels, I can only pursue
this project as an independent study.
The novels I propose to read are Adam Bede, The Mill on the Floss, and
Daniel Deronda. These are extremely long novels, but l am confident that
I can complete the reading in one semester. I will also read critical essays
on these novels and reviews of them that appeared during Eliot's lifetime.
Please let me know if you would be willing to sponsor this project.
